{{See also|Guide for new players|Advancements}}
'''Progression''' in [[Matcha Flavoured]] follows a fixed chain of workstations and metals, and the Tutorial [[Advancements|advancements]] trace that chain. There are no stone tools: equipment goes from wood to [[Copper equipment|copper]], [[Iron equipment|iron]] and [[Diamond equipment|diamond]], and each metal needs a hotter furnace than the one before. This page lists each step with the recipe or rule that makes it necessary.

== Stages ==
{| class="wikitable"
! # !! Step !! How !! Advancement
|-
| 1 || Wood || Logs unlock the recipes for sticks, [[Kindling|kindling]] and chests, and planks unlock the wooden tools.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/logs.json}}</ref> A wooden pickaxe (200 durability) mines stone, coal and copper, but not deepslate, iron, gold, silver, diamond or sulfur ores.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/block/non_mineable/wood.json}}</ref> || —
|-
| 2 || Fire || Kindling is crafted unlit (2 sticks over 2 logs). Light it with [[tinder]] (2 sticks and short grass, fern or bush; single use) or a [[Fire Starter|fire starter]] (2 flint).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/campfire.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/tinder.json}}</ref> || Prometheus be Damned
|-
| 3 || Dry grass || Short grass only drops itself when broken with a hoe or shears; with a hoe, it drops [[Wheat Grain|wheat grain]] instead 12.5% of the time. Cook short grass or fern on the kindling (10 seconds) to get short dry grass.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/short_grass.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/campfire/short_dry_grass_campfire.json}}</ref> || Harvester
|-
| 4 || Mud kiln || Short dry grass + dirt → 1 [[Packed Mud|packed mud]]; 4 packed mud → 4 mud bricks. A [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]] takes 4 mud bricks, 2 packed mud and 1 kindling.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/packed_mud_from_dirt.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/mudkiln.json}}</ref> || Ancient Technology
|-
| 5 || Copper || Smelt raw copper in the mud kiln. The kiln also turns cobblestone into [[Limestone|limestone]] (stone), limestone into smooth stone, clay balls into bricks, sand into glass and logs into charcoal.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/kiln/copper_ingot_from_smoking_raw_copper.json}}</ref> Copper tools, including the [[mattock]] and [[dolabra]], can mine deepslate, iron and silver ores, but not gold or diamond.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/block/non_mineable/copper.json}}</ref> || Brazier {{G|E010}}, Two in One, Mason
|-
| 6 || Blast furnace || 4 polished deepslate, 2 smooth stone and 1 kindling.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/blast_furnace.json}}</ref> Iron, gold, [[Raw Silver|silver]] and [[Raw Diamond|diamond]] can only be smelted here. || Burgeoning Metallurge
|-
| 7 || Iron, gold, silver, diamond || Smelt raw ores in the [[blast furnace]]. Diamond ore drops raw diamond.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/diamond_ore.json}}</ref> Iron tools mine everything except obsidian. || The Stalwart Metal {{G|E010}}, The Generous Metal, The Warding Metal, The Resilient Mineral {{G|E010}}
|-
| 8 || Oven || 3 iron ingots, 4 blocks of bricks and 1 kindling. Five bricks also make 4 [[bowl]]s, needed for the oven meals. See [[Cooking]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/oven.json}}</ref> || Now You're Cooking, Manners First
|-
| 9 || Steel and smithing || 4 iron ingots + 1 coal block → 4 [[Carbon-Rich Iron|carbon-rich iron]]; blast it into [[Steel Alloy|steel alloy]] (5 seconds). 2 steel + 4 planks make a [[Smithing Table|smithing table]]; 3 steel + 4 iron make an [[anvil]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/carbon_rich_iron.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/smithing_table.json}}</ref> || A Brittle Alloy?, A Tough Alloy, Master Metallurge
|-
| 10 || Alloys || Apply alloys in the smithing table: steel on iron, [[Hepatizon Alloy|hepatizon]] and [[Shakudo Alloy|shakudo]] on copper, [[Electrum Alloy|electrum]] and [[Adamant Alloy|adamant]] on diamond. See [[Alloy]] and [[Smithing]]. || A Keen Alloy, A Gentle Alloy, A Zealous Alloy {{G|E010}}, A Divine Alloy {{G|E010}}
|-
| 11 || Magic || [[Estus Ash|Estus ash]] from undead, [[Benzene|benzene]] from Hell, and a [[Stable Void|stable void]] make [[Stabilized Estus|stabilized Estus]], the base of [[Warding Stone|warding stones]], [[Hell-Bound Book|hell-bound books]] and [[Eye of Ender|eyes of ender]]. See [[Enchanting]]. || Orpheus {{G|E010}}, Hell tab
|-
| 12 || The End || Eyes of ender need [[Divine Fragment|divine fragments]] from spawners or strong mobs. Killing the [[Ender Dragon]] makes the [[Surface|surface]] safe. || The End of Dreams {{G|E010}}, Iconoclast
|}

Milestones marked {{G|E010}} lower the player's minimum hearts; see [[Advancements#Rewards]] and [[Death]]. Progressing quickly therefore makes death more costly sooner, which the developer suggests avoiding by slowing down.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.2|quote=Progressing fast will make you loose hearts faster than progressing slow.}}</ref>
